purpose: Compare alpha-specific theorem-guided Space-Saving capacity with a constant Space-Saving counter capacity across all Zipf alpha values

policies.alpha_specific: Theorem-7 sufficient bound for alpha >= 1; full-alphabet fallback for alpha < 1

fixed.selection_basis: Pre-existing project diagnostic budget; selected before the runs; >= topk

pairing: Both policies process the exact same generated event vector and use the same exact Top-100 ground truth for each alpha/repeat seed.
notes: This is a supplementary Space-Saving-only experiment, not a replacement for the Figure 6 replication.
The fixed 1000-counter budget is a project-selected diagnostic setting, not specified by the original paper.
The alpha-specific policy is based on the UCSB 2005-23 technical report Theorem 7 proof and its documented alpha<1 fallback.
